description.text: The other XY5 expansion, released on 13 December 2014 alongside Gaia Volcano: the sea pack, with Primal Kyogre on the wrapper, after its appearance in Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire that November. Primal Kyogre-EX carries an Ancient Trait, the new kind of special power these packs introduced. Kyogre-EX, Gardevoir-EX and M Gardevoir-EX, Wailord-EX and Sharpedo-EX join it, with the Mudkip line. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 70, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-EX and Supporters, among them Archie's Ace in the Hole, and two Ultra Rares. In English it became part of Primal Clash in February 2015, together with Gaia Volcano.
